thesis_statement: ITA (iShares US Aerospace & Defense ETF) is a diversified proxy for US defense and commercial-aerospace spending, supported by elevated defense budgets and the commercial aircraft production ramp.

base.summary: Defense budgets stay elevated and commercial aerospace keeps ramping; the ETF compounds with the sector.

bull.summary: New multi-year procurement or geopolitical escalation accelerates orders.

bear.summary: Budget cuts, a continuing resolution, or aerospace supply-chain problems stall the sector.

key_risks: Top-two concentration: GE Aerospace 21.6% and RTX 17.2% (about 39% combined), so ITA behaves largely like a GE/RTX basket.
GE and RTX are also individually tracked names, so ITA signals overlap with theirs and are not independent evidence.
Policy and budget timing risk; an ETF has no single company thesis to check.

invalidation_reasons.price: Close below the live guarded-SQL reference_invalidation_level (205.72 at the 2026-09-26 renewal). SQL governs after any later renewal; this text does not.
fundamental: Enacted US defense budget cut in real terms.
Sustained commercial aerospace production cuts at the major OEMs.
